formats.key: invest(address token, uint256 amount, address recipient, uint256 proofAmount, bytes32[] proofWL)
effects: Pulls `amount` of `token` from the signer into PutManager, which deposits it into the token's yield vault (_invest: safeTransferFrom(payer, this, amount); _vault.deposit(amount)).
Mints a pFT put-position NFT to `recipient`. The NFT holds an FT allocation (ftOut) set by the oracle price and a strike (pFT.mint(recipient, amount, ftOut, strike, token, ftPerUSD)).
When an ACL is set and proofAmount != 0, uses up part of the signer's whitelist allocation (ftACL.invest(msg.sender, token, amount, proofAmount)).
formats.shown: Invest 1 USDC; the fields show the collateral amount with its token, the recipient address, and the whitelist cap as a raw number.

findings.title: invest: interpolated intent omits the recipient of the put position and does not say a position NFT is minted.
findings.evidence: descriptor interpolatedIntent "Invest {amount}"; PutManager._invest: id = pFT.mint(recipient, ...). In case 0 the recipient is 0xd8dA…6045, not the signer, and is shown only as a separate field.
findings.fix: Use "Invest {amount} in FT PUT for {recipient}" so the sentence says who receives the position.

findings.title: invest: the FT allocation the position receives is computed from the oracle and is not shown.
findings.evidence: PutManager._invest: (ftOut, strike, ftPerUSD) = getAssetFTPrice(token, amount, ...); pFT.mint(recipient, amount, ftOut, strike, ...). Nothing in calldata bounds ftOut.
findings.fix: No calldata field carries it. A short note in the intent that the FT amount is set at the oracle price would help.

findings.title: invest: the whitelist cap is shown as a raw integer with no token units.
findings.evidence: descriptor field proofAmount format "raw"; case 0 screen "Whitelist cap: 5000000" next to "1 USDC". It is passed with token and amount to ftACL.invest, but the ACL source is not in the directory, so its units are not confirmed.
findings.fix: If the cap is in collateral units, format it as tokenAmount with tokenPath "token".

findings.title: invest: recipient addressName types are limited to wallet/eoa, but any non-zero address can receive the position.
findings.evidence: descriptor recipient params types ["wallet","eoa"]; PutManager.invest only checks recipient != address(0).
findings.fix: Widen the types to include contract, or drop the types restriction.

effects: Reduces or burns the signer's pFT put position `id` by `amount_ft` of its FT allocation (pFT.divest(msg.sender, id, amount_ft, _capitalDivesting)). In case 1 the NFT was burned.

Pays the signer back collateral from the vault. The amount is amount_ft converted at the position's stored strike and ftPerUSD (collateralFromFT), and the token is the position's collateral (_vault.withdraw(_capitalDivesting, msg.sender)). In case 1 this was 3832.237329 USDT.
No FT token moves in this call. amount_ft is the size of the put allocation being given up.
formats.shown: Divest 38303.22 FT from pFT NFT #6339; the fields show the position id and an FT amount.

findings.title: divest: the screen never says collateral is paid back to the signer, and the reader missed the USDT received.
findings.evidence: PutManager.divest: _vault.withdraw(_capitalDivesting, msg.sender). Case 1 mined: 3832.237329 USDT in to the signer. Screen intent "Divest FT PUT" and fields Position / FT amount only; reader: "Not shown on screen: no asset or amount is listed as received".
findings.fix: Use an intent like "Exercise FT put: return FT allocation for your collateral" and "Sell {amount_ft} back from {id} for your collateral".

findings.title: divest: the collateral asset and amount received come from stored position data and cannot be shown.
findings.evidence: PutManager.divest: (token,..,strike,..,ftPerUSD) = pFT.puts(id); _capitalDivesting = collateralFromFT(amount_ft, strike, ...). The token and strike are in storage, not in calldata.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show the amount. State in the intent that the position's collateral is returned.

findings.title: divest: "FT amount" shown as FT tokens suggests FT moves, but only the put allocation is given up.
findings.evidence: descriptor amount_ft label "FT amount" tokenAmount token ftToken. Case 1 mined has no FT transfer. Reader: "38303.22 FT worth of position value taken out".
findings.fix: Relabel to "FT allocation sold back" or "Put size exercised".

findings.title: divest: the screen does not say the position NFT is burned when fully divested.
findings.evidence: Case 1 mined: ftPUT #6339 out from the signer to 0x0. Screen shows only "Position: pFT NFT #6339"; reader unsure "Whether the NFT is burned or just reduced".
findings.fix: Say in the intent that the position is reduced, and closed when fully divested.

cases.notes: The position id is shown but not that it is burned. The 3832.24 USDT received is not shown anywhere.

effects: Sends `amount` FT from PutManager to the signer (FT.safeTransfer(msg.sender, amount)).

Removes `amount` from the signer's pFT position `id`, giving up the put right to redeem that part for collateral; burns the NFT when fully withdrawn (pFT.withdrawFT(msg.sender, id, amount, _capitalDivesting)). In case 2 the NFT was burned.
The matching collateral is set aside for the protocol multisig (capitalDivesting[token] += ...), not the signer.
formats.shown: Withdraw 149831.856 FT from pFT NFT #268; the fields show the position and the FT amount.

findings.title: withdrawFT: the intent does not say the put protection is forfeited and the position is burned.
findings.evidence: PutManager.withdrawFT comment "Withdraw FT (invalidating PUT position)"; capitalDivesting[token] += _capitalDivesting goes to msig. Case 2 mined: ftPUT #268 out to 0x0. Reader unsure "Whether withdrawing forfeits the put (sell-back) rights".
findings.fix: Use "Withdraw {amount} from {id} (gives up put protection on this amount)".

cases.notes: The FT received matches exactly. The position is shown, but not that it is burned.

couldNotCheck: The pFT position contract 0xa4215Daaf3745E14E96E169E0E7706c479Ce04F2 is not in the directory. Its mint, divest and withdrawFT code decides whether the signer's NFT is reduced or burned, and checks ownership.

The ftYieldWrapper vaults (e.g. 0x267df6b6…cb36 ftUSDT) are not in the directory. Their withdraw(amount, to) decides which asset (the underlying or a wrapper) and how much reaches the signer on divest.

invest(address token, uint256 amount, ad.worst: invest: interpolated intent omits the recipient of the put position and does not say a position NFT is minted.

divest(uint256 id, uint256 amount_ft).worst: divest: the screen never says collateral is paid back to the signer, and the reader missed the USDT received.

summary.worst: invest: interpolated intent omits the recipient of the put position and does not say a position NFT is minted.
